entries.9cc663d29161d644: Real estate owners of rental apartments
entries.9e8e362dbca0bf54: A real estate company based in Kyoto that operates with two pillars: contracted management of rental apartments and leasing of its own properties.
entries.c4dff670ffe937ce: A business that is entrusted by real estate owners with the management of rental apartments and provides, on a one-stop basis, services necessary for rental management, including resident management, building maintenance, renovation work, rental brokerage and sales brokerage.
entries.d95190daf173ccff: A business that leases the company's own properties and sublease properties.
entries.df20c0df138d24f4: A business that leases the company's own properties and sublease properties. It acquires mainly relatively aged, high-quality properties with high asset efficiency, and maintains a high occupancy rate through renovations that utilize know-how gained from the property management business. As of March 31, 2026, the company's own properties totaled 7,148 units in 164 buildings, with an occupancy rate of 99.1%. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥6,555 million, of which rental income and monthly-rental sales, etc. were ¥6,251 million and other sales were ¥304 million.
entries.e256d7e36955a368: Headquartered in Shimogyo-ku, Kyoto City, the company and three non-consolidated subsidiaries form a group. It operates property management and property leasing businesses, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 261. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.f629ef5271c02c2e: A business that is entrusted by real estate owners with the management of rental apartments and provides, on a one-stop basis, services necessary for rental management, including resident management, building maintenance, renovation work, rental brokerage and sales brokerage. It has set up 25 management centers, responding to room troubles 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and as of March 31, 2026, the number of units under management was 29,279 (including the company's own properties). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥4,452 million, consisting of construction sales of ¥1,859 million, management income of ¥1,743 million, other sales of ¥596 million, and rental income and monthly-rental sales, etc. of ¥252 million.
